2609.03773.title: RealCADBench: Benchmarking Parametric CAD Modeling from Industrial Design Intents
2609.03773.paper_summary: Parametric computer-aided design (CAD) modeling is difficult to evaluate with a single metric. Existing CAD benchmarks often emphasize synthetic or CAD-native settings, limited input modalities, or executability and IoUs alone. We introduce RealCADBench, a benchmark for intent-to-program CAD modeling from real industrial design intents. It contains 12,632 tasks from 19 factory-automation categories and spans text descriptions, 2D engineering drawings, real product pictures, and rendered images for both Part and Assembly modeling. We report results on a 1,770-task evaluation slice: 1,745 Part tasks across four input regimes and RCB-Assm25, a 25-task assembly study used in every reported assembly comparison. Each method generates FreeCAD API Python, which a shared runtime executes to export the 3D model. We evaluate the exported model using executability, Solid IoU, Surface IoU, and a rubric-based visual-semantic identity Judge. Among the nine standalone frontier large models evaluated, no model leads all four metrics. Across six frontier-scale large models, executability ranges from 0.565 to 0.812, Solid IoU from 0.2841 to 0.5379, and Surface IoU from 0.112 to 0.217 across the four Part regimes. The highest regime-balanced composite comes from a different model than the leaders on the four component metrics. On RCB-Assm25, Codex with GPT-5.5 improves executability and both IoU metrics over standalone GPT-5.5, but lowers the Judge score by 6.98 percentage points, leaving GPT-5.5 as the Judge leader. We also observe recurring failure modes, most notably missing fine structures, loss of part identity, and incorrect assembly placement. These results show that execution alone is insufficient to characterize realistic CAD modeling and that frontier models and agents differ substantially across executability, IoUs, and visual-semantic identity.
2609.03773.paper_summary_zh: 參數化電腦輔助設計 (CAD) 建模難以用單一指標進行評估。現有的 CAD 基準通常強調合成或 CAD 原生環境、有限的輸入模式，或僅關注可執行性和 IoU。我們介紹 RealCADBench，這是一個基於真實工業設計意圖的意圖編程 CAD 建模基準。它包含來自 19 個工廠自動化類別的 12,632 個任務，涵蓋文本描述、2D 工程圖、真實產品圖片和用於零件和組裝建模的渲染圖像。我們報告了一個 1,770 任務評估切片的結果：1,745 個零件任務，跨越四種輸入模式，以及 RCB-Assm25，一個在每個報告的組裝比較中使用的 25 任務組裝研究。每種方法生成 FreeCAD API Python，該共享運行時執行以導出 3D 模型。我們使用可執行性、固體 IoU、表面 IoU 和基於評分標準的視覺語義身份評判來評估導出的模型。在評估的九個獨立前沿大型模型中，沒有一個模型在所有四個指標上領先。在六個前沿規模的大型模型中，可執行性範圍從 0.565 到 0.812，固體 IoU 從 0.2841 到 0.5379，表面 IoU 在四個零件模式中範圍從 0.112 到 0.217。最高的模式平衡綜合來自於不同於四個組件指標領導者的模型。在 RCB-Assm25 中，Codex 與 GPT-5.5 在可執行性和兩個 IoU 指標上優於獨立的 GPT-5.5，但評判分數降低了 6.98 個百分點，使 GPT-5.5 成為評判領導者。我們還觀察到重複的失敗模式，最顯著的是缺失精細結構、零件身份丟失和組裝位置不正確。這些結果表明，僅僅依賴執行不足以表徵現實的 CAD 建模，並且前沿模型和代理在可執行性、IoU 和視覺語義身份上有顯著差異。
